hoi.tv.phai_phi_tinh: The flying-star layer (a palace's stem transforming a star that flies to another palace) is the method of the Zhong Zhou / Qin Tian schools; the Vietnamese Southern school mainly reads the Four Transformations by birth-year stem, the void stars and the triads. The two readings are shown side by side for you to compare.

hoi.tv.yd.cach_ghep.di_hay_o: The Southern school shows how strong the urge to change is (Tian Ma, Po Jun, Tian Ji, the void stars, where the Body Palace sits); the flying-star layer shows whether work is flowing or stuck this year. Both are shown, with what to prepare if you go and if you stay; you decide.
hoi.tv.yd.cach_ghep.tai_van: The Southern school speaks about your base of savings (Tian Fu as a store, the Property Palace); the flying-star layer shows where money comes in and goes out easily. Together they become tendencies and habits worth keeping; no money figures, no financial products.
hoi.tv.yd.cach_ghep.hoc_hanh_con: Only about how a parent can be there for the child and which months to go easier on studies; no predicting grades, no choosing a school or career for the child. For a closer look, use the child's own chart.
hoi.tv.yd.cach_ghep.phan_van: Each option is linked to a palace that represents it; the flights of each palace are shown as an angle to weigh, with a question to reflect on. We do not say which option is right or tell you to drop one.
hoi.tv.yd.cach_ghep.ba_thang_toi: Uses the three-month rhythm: each month gets a level — Favourable, Neutral or Take care — with the reason, what to do and a question to reflect on. Southern-school moving stars describe the background; no weighting, no naming the month something will happen.
hoi.tv.yd.cach_ghep.chon_thoi_diem: Suggests the favourable months by the rhythm of the transformations and points to the Good-day finder for a specific day. Timing is only one factor; your preparation matters more.
hoi.tv.yd.cach_ghep.tong_quan_nam: Read in the order 10-year period > annual chart > minor yearly limit; each area (work, money, love, family, travel, friends) gets its theme and what to do. The Health Palace only speaks about daily rhythm; no predicting events.
hoi.tv.yd.cach_ghep.hieu_ban_than: Brings together the main stars, their Southern-school brightness and the transformation flights into a portrait with strengths, things to watch and a question to reflect on; the 10-year periods are read as the theme of each stage of life, not a fixed timetable.
